object.value: A measured or inferred description of the surrounding acoustic environment.
Acoustic classifications alone do not establish human communication.
An audio-signal level or intensity summary.
The signal level does not identify its source or meaning.
A photoplethysmographic pulse signal or a summary of that signal.
A low class fraction may mean that sensing time was assigned to another class, not that data were missing.
Expected coverage for an inference class
The fraction of expected sensing time assigned to a specified inference class.
The Wi-Fi network to which a device is connected.
An inference or summary of conversation activity.
Detected conversation activity does not by itself identify participants, content or social meaning.
Sensing availability and the coverage and classification of recorded observations.
Data availability is distinct from accuracy or fitness for analysis.
An individual beat interval is distinct from a statistic describing variability across intervals.
An interval between successive detected heart beats.
Device acceleration alone does not establish human activity.
Typing or keyboard interaction does not by itself establish communication or social activity.
A magnetic-field reading alone does not identify location or human activity.
Nearby-device observations do not by themselves establish location, co-presence, or social interaction.
Device rotation alone does not establish human activity.
A device or record time-zone setting is not evidence of an observed location.
Domains and quantities described by measurements and derived features.
Measurements and derived features concerning physical activity, movement, or exercise.
Measurements and derived features concerning body or skin temperature.
Skin temperature and core body temperature are distinct quantities.
Measurements and derived features concerning cardiovascular activity, including heart rate, pulse, and beat intervals.
Communication signals and social-context proxies do not by themselves identify or establish a social interaction.
Measurements and derived features concerning communication activity or social-context proxies.
Measurements and metadata concerning device state, configuration, wear, or acquisition context.
Measurements and derived features concerning interaction with applications and digital devices.
Electrodermal activity alone does not identify stress, emotion or a clinical state.
Measurements and derived features concerning electrodermal activity signals.
Measurements and derived features concerning the surrounding physical or acoustic environment.
Measurements and derived features concerning location, mobility patterns, or spatial context.
Measurements and derived features concerning respiratory activity.
Measurements and derived features concerning sleep timing, duration, stage, or structure.
Sleep measures can be obtained through self-report, sensing or computation; the acquisition method remains part of their interpretation.
A measurement or derived feature concerning phone-call activity.
Call activity describes the occurrence or duration of calls, not their content.
An audio signal alone does not identify its environmental or social context.
Raw or minimally processed audio-sensor signals and classifications.
Raw or minimally interpreted sensor signals and their acquisition context.
A classifier output is not necessarily a verified environmental or human-activity fact.
A label or score assigned by an audio classifier.
An unknown classification is not evidence that audio data were absent.
The fraction or amount of sensed audio for which an inference remains unclassified.
Wi-Fi networks visible to a device.
An inference or summary of detected voice activity.
Detection does not identify a speaker or establish a conversation.
Observations of connected or visible Wi-Fi networks.
Wi-Fi observations alone do not establish location or social interaction.
